Resolves #21975

Nine catalog examples with both Neo themes now open on the scheme the Portal asks for. Before this, the theme request changed nothing in them:
- Meridian Observatory, Operations Desk, Dock Choreography Demo, Layouts Side by Side and Browser-Style Tabs always opened in Neo Dark.
- Markdown VDOM, Animated List, GraphScene and amCharts Pie always opened in Neo Light.

Each `app.mjs` now gives its main view `theme: resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)`, the line 35 examples on `dev` already carry.

Evidence: L3 (headless sweeps of the nine at the head and on `dev`, plus the local e2e and component specs that load them) → L3 required (AC-1 to AC-4).

CI jobs: +0.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside CI, the sweep below. Each of the nine opens on the requested Neo theme, on the body and on the root viewport. On `dev`, all nine ignore both requests. CI e2e: `dashboard/ChoreographyStartTheme.spec.mjs` covers Dock Choreography's SharedWorker case. It opens two tabs with opposite requests, then asserts each tab's body and viewport while the first stays open. |
| AC-2 | Outside CI, the sweeps below. Without a request, a browser that prefers light opens each on `themes[0]`, as on `dev`. A browser that prefers dark opens all nine in Neo Dark. |
| AC-3 | Outside CI, the sweep below. After the opposite request, the ThemeSwitcher's first switch turns each example to its default theme. After a light request, Meridian's menu marks Neo Light as checked. |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: no console or page error in the sweep's 36 loads at the head. |

## Deltas from ticket
- Dock Choreography runs on a SharedWorker, whose `Neo.config` is the first tab's. In Sophie's review a second tab opened on the first tab's theme. Its start theme now comes from the booting window's configuration (`Neo.windowConfigs?.[Neo.bootingWindowId] || Neo.config`), the same lookup `apps/workstation` and `list/onAir` use. On `dev`, `dashboard/sortable` shows the same two-tab defect; it is outside this ticket and noted in a defect-note.
- AC-2 was corrected after a measurement. Without a request, the resolver follows a dark browser preference, so the four light-first examples now open in Neo Dark in such a browser, as the resolver's 35 other callers do. On `dev` they open in Neo Light. The ticket body records this.

## Test Evidence
The sweep at `6b506e1f33`: headless Chromium at 1280 × 800, each example loaded with a Neo Dark request, a Neo Light request and none, reading the theme class on `<body>` and on the root viewport. The two agree in every load.

| Examples | Neo Dark request | Neo Light request | No request | First switch after the opposite request |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| scheduler/meridian, dashboard/desk, dashboard/choreography, layout/sideBySide, tab/browser | `neo-theme-neo-dark` | `neo-theme-neo-light` | `neo-theme-neo-dark` | from Neo Light to `neo-theme-neo-dark` |
| component/markdown, list/animate, component/graphScene, charts | `neo-theme-neo-dark` | `neo-theme-neo-light` | `neo-theme-neo-light` | from Neo Dark to `neo-theme-neo-light` |

On `dev`, both request columns match the "No request" column in every row.

In a browser that prefers dark, with no request, all nine open on `neo-theme-neo-dark` at the head. On `dev`, markdown, list/animate, graphScene and charts open on `neo-theme-neo-light`.

Specs that load the nine, run locally at the head:
- Component tier: 10/10 (`DeskSelection`, `SideBySide`, `BrowserTabs`).
- e2e: 36 of 37. The red one is `GraphScene.spec.mjs` "a native pointer stays canvas-local through pane translation and offset resize". It fails at the same assertion with `dev`'s `app.mjs` (1 of 5 runs) as at the head (1 of 3), so it is intermittent and not caused by this change.

Two Dock Choreography tabs in one browser context, the first still open, so the second boots in the same SharedWorker:

| Requests, in order | At `6b506e1f33` | At `c81fca1a52` |
|---|---|---|
| Neo Light, then Neo Dark | both tabs `neo-theme-neo-light` | each tab on its own request |
| Neo Dark, then Neo Light | both tabs `neo-theme-neo-dark` | each tab on its own request |

`ChoreographyStartTheme.spec.mjs` fails 2 of 2 at "second tab: body" with `6b506e1f33`'s `app.mjs`, and passes 2 of 2 at `c81fca1a52`. Re-swept at `c81fca1a52`, Choreography still opens on each single-tab request and on `themes[0]` without one, and its first switch follows. There were no errors.

The same catalog URL, whole page at 1440 × 900. In the dev column, the head's checkout has `dev`'s entry file swapped back in:

| Request | dev | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| Operations Desk, `?theme=neo-theme-neo-light` | ![dev](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bfe4f99cc63c04d476a05cf0c147d625db53bae4/review-evidence/21975/base-dock-layouts-neo-light-request-1440x900.png?raw=true) opens `neo-theme-neo-dark` | ![head](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bfe4f99cc63c04d476a05cf0c147d625db53bae4/review-evidence/21975/head-dock-layouts-neo-light-request-1440x900.png?raw=true) opens `neo-theme-neo-light` |
| Markdown VDOM, `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark` | ![dev](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bfe4f99cc63c04d476a05cf0c147d625db53bae4/review-evidence/21975/base-markdown-neo-dark-request-1440x900.png?raw=true) opens `neo-theme-neo-light` | ![head](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bfe4f99cc63c04d476a05cf0c147d625db53bae4/review-evidence/21975/head-markdown-neo-dark-request-1440x900.png?raw=true) opens `neo-theme-neo-dark` |

Frame critique:
- In the dark Markdown frame, the "neo repo" link keeps the browser's default blue, `rgb(0, 0, 238)` on `rgb(13, 15, 18)`. The color is the same when Neo Dark comes from the switcher on `dev`, because `component/markdown/Component.css` has no link rule. Out of scope, noted in a defect-note.
- In both Markdown frames, the code block's background follows each line's length, so it reads like a text selection. It is not caused by this change. Out of scope, noted in a defect-note.
